title: 第5章 生子当如蓝星第6章 帝王心术
lines: 天玄一脸震惊地看着宁宸，小小年纪，竟有如此文学底蕴。
生子当如蓝星。
“看来我大玄皇朝不久的将来，要出以为名动文坛的人物了。”
天玄不吝夸赞。
就连一直看不上宁宸的娘娘腔，此时也选择了沉默。
他虽然不是很懂诗词，但宁宸这首词中的意境傻子都能听得出来有多高？
这首词一出，相信过不了多久，就会震惊整个京城。
宁宸憨笑，“我不想出名，我就想吃饱穿暖。”
就在这时，敲门声响起。
娘娘腔走过去打开门。
几个状元楼的伙计鱼贯而入，手里都端着托盘，上面是美味佳肴。
宁宸看着他们往桌上摆，忍不住直咽口水。
太玄看了他一眼，笑道：“蓝星，坐。”
宁宸试探着问道：“你要请我吃饭吗？”
天玄点头。
宁宸实在太饿了，大病初愈，从昨天到现在，一口饭没吃。
看宁宸坐下，天玄道：“吃吧，不用客气！”
“谢谢大叔，那我就不客气了！”
宁宸饿极了，顾不上礼节，开始狼吞虎咽，大快朵颐。
天玄静静地看着他吃，没动筷子。
“真粗鲁！”
看着宁宸狼吞虎咽，娘娘腔一脸嫌弃。
可惜，他和大胡子，连坐的份都没有，都恭敬地站在天玄身后。
宁宸终于吃饱了，打了个饱嗝。
他抬起头才发现，天玄一口没吃，有些不好意思，“大叔，你怎么不吃啊？”
“我不饿！”
“那这半只烧鸡我能打包带走吗？”
天玄看着他，“你经常吃不饱吗？”
宁宸点头。
“那我让人重新给你打包一只。”
“不用了，我打包这半只就行了。”
天玄也没勉强，微微点头，旋即话锋一转，“你这首词，打算卖多少钱？”
宁宸想了想，“大叔看着给吧？你都请我吃饭了，我可以算你便宜点。”
天玄思索了一下，“一百两如何？”
宁宸张大了嘴。
发了，发财了！
一百两银子，相当于一个三品大员一年的俸禄了。
宁自明是二品大员，每年俸禄一百五十两。
当然，这只是正常工资，要是加上养廉银，还有其他福利，灰色收入，一年收入大概在上万两银子。
一百两银子，可以在京城偏僻的地方，买个两进的小院了。
十多分钟后，带着一张一百两的银票，还有一两银子...对了，还有半只烧鸡。
离开的时候，天玄告诉宁宸，他会隔个三五天，来状元楼一趟...如果有好的诗词，可以找他。
宁宸离开后，天玄还在想那首词，忍不住赞叹：“好词，真是好词！”
娘娘腔急忙道：“恭喜陛下，贺喜陛下...这首词一出，陛下的威望肯定更上一层楼！”
天玄不是别人，正是当今圣上，玄帝！
content_en:
Tian Xuan looked at Ning Chen in shock. At such a young age, he actually had such a literary background.
When you give birth to a child, you should be like a blue star.
"It seems that our Daxuan Dynasty will become a famous figure in the literary world in the near future."
Tian Xuan did not hesitate to praise.
Even the sissy who had always looked down on Ning Chen chose to remain silent at this time.
Although he doesn't understand poetry very well, how high can a fool understand the artistic conception in Ning Chen's poem?
Once this poem comes out, I believe it will shock the entire capital in a short time.
Ning Chen smiled naively, "I don't want to be famous, I just want to be fed and clothed."
Just then, there was a knock on the door.
Sissy walked over and opened the door.
Several waiters from Zhuangyuanlou filed in, all holding trays with delicacies in their hands.
Ning Chen watched them put them on the table and couldn't help but swallow his saliva.
Tai Xuan glanced at him and said with a smile: "Lan Xing, sit down."
Ning Chen asked tentatively: "Do you want to treat me to dinner?"
Tianxuan nodded.
Ning Chen was really hungry. He had just recovered from a serious illness. He hadn't eaten a bite of food from yesterday to now.
Seeing Ning Chen sit down, Tian Xuan said: "Eat, you're welcome!"
"Thank you, uncle, then I'm welcome!"
Ning Chen was so hungry that he ignored the etiquette and began to devour the food.
Tian Xuan watched him eat quietly without moving his chopsticks.
"How rude!"
Seeing Ning Chen devouring his food, Sissy looked disgusted.
It's a pity that he and Big Beard didn't even have a seat, so they both stood respectfully behind Tian Xuan.
Ning Chen was finally full and burped.
He raised his head and realized that Tian Xuan hadn't eaten a bite, and he was a little embarrassed, "Uncle, why don't you eat?"
"I'm not hungry!"
"Then can I take this half of the roast chicken away?"
Tianxuan looked at him, "Are you often not full?"
Ning Chen nodded.
"Then I'll have someone repackage one for you."
"No, I'll just pack this half."
Tian Xuan didn't force it, nodded slightly, and then changed the topic, "How much do you plan to sell this poem for?"
Ning Chen thought for a while, "Uncle, can you give it to me? You've already invited me to dinner, so I can give you a discount."
Tianxuan thought for a moment, "How about one hundred taels?"
Ning Chen opened his mouth wide.
Get rich, get rich!
One hundred taels of silver is equivalent to a year's salary of a third-grade official.
Ning Ziming is a second-grade official with an annual salary of one hundred and fifty taels.
Of course, this is just the normal salary. If you add in Yanglianyin, other benefits, and gray income, your annual income will be about tens of thousands of taels of silver.
With one hundred taels of silver, you can buy a small courtyard with two entrances in a remote place in the capital.
More than ten minutes later, I had a one-hundred-tael silver note, another tael of silver... and, by the way, half a roast chicken.
When leaving, Tianxuan told Ning Chen that he would come to Zhuangyuan Building every three to five days... If you have good poems, you can find him.
After Ning Chen left, Tian Xuan was still thinking about the poem and couldn't help but praise: "Good words, really good words!"
The sissy said hurriedly: "Congratulations to your majesty, congratulations to your majesty... As soon as this poem comes out, your majesty's prestige will definitely rise to the next level!"
Tianxuan is none other than the current Holy Emperor, Emperor Xuan!
title_en: Chapter 5: Giving birth to a child should be like a blue star Chapter 6: The emperor’s mind
